name: Luu Bang
role: Founding emperor of the Han dynasty; victor of the Chu–Han Contention
known_facts: Born a commoner in Pei and served as a minor local official (village head)
Rose in rebellion after the collapse of the Qin dynasty
Defeated Xiang Yu (Hạng Vũ) in the Chu–Han Contention
Founded the Han dynasty in 202 BCE
Relied on Zhang Liang (Trương Lương) for strategy, Xiao He (Tiêu Hà) for logistics and Han Xin (Hàn Tín) as general
interpretation: Late-Qin to early-Han Chinese dress, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
